63.solution: Elastomers are polymers whose chains are held by weak van der Waals forces, so they stretch and spring back. Buna-S, a styrene-butadiene rubber, is an elastomer. Nylon 6,6 and Terylene are fibres, and polythene is a thermoplastic. Answer: A.

64.solution: In the Wolff-Kishner reduction the carbonyl compound first condenses with hydrazine, \(\mathrm{NH_2NH_2}\), to form a hydrazone. Heating the hydrazone with KOH in ethylene glycol then removes \(\mathrm{N_2}\) and gives the alkane. Answer: C.

68.solution: Chlorine on the benzene ring deactivates it but directs the incoming group to the ortho and para positions. Nitration with conc. \(\mathrm{HNO_3}\) and conc. \(\mathrm{H_2SO_4}\) therefore gives a mixture of 1-chloro-2-nitrobenzene and 1-chloro-4-nitrobenzene, the para isomer being major. Answer: C.

70.subtopic: Batteries, Primary, Secondary and Fuel Cells
70.solution: In a dry cell the electrolyte is a moist paste of \(\mathrm{NH_4Cl}\) and \(\mathrm{ZnCl_2}\). Starch is added to thicken this paste so that the electrolyte does not leak out of the cell. Answer: C.

87.subtopic: Chemical Reactions and Basicity of Amines
87.solution: Acylation replaces a hydrogen on nitrogen by an acyl group, so only primary and secondary amines react. N-Methylaniline, \(\mathrm{C_6H_5NHCH_3}\), is a secondary amine with one N-H hydrogen. Ethyldimethylamine, N,N-dimethylmethanamine and N,N-dimethylaniline are tertiary amines with no N-H hydrogen. Answer: B.
